678-2511-4022.notablePrerequisites: A permanent you control has left the battlefield this turn
678-2511-4022.description:
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying its mana cost.
When Hidden Herbalists enters, it triggers, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Hidden Herbalists.
When Hidden Herbalists dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Hidden Herbalists from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat.

2079-3755-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1703-4984-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Academy Researchers
When Academy Researchers dies, Fool's Demise first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Academy Researchers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Academy Researchers enters, it triggers, putting Fool's Demise onto the battlefield from your hand attached to Academy Researchers.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

3532-3835-5078-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3835-5078-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2921-5434-5555-7666.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2921-5434-5555-7666.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2.

206-339-677-2921.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1558-3147-3875-4231-4772.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3147-3875-4231-4772.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Doubling Season.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1171-1409-2079.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

1115-2366-5234-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1115-2366-5234-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1315-1479-1659.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-1659.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Seed the Land and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

11-1927-2103-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-1927-2103-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Capture of Jingzhou.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Capture of Jingzhou spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Capture of Jingzhou spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Capture of Jingzhou and returning the original Capture of Jingzhou to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Capture of Jingzhou from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1305-7009-7068.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1305-7009-7068.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk. Choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability given to it by Barbara Wright.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

5256-5572-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5256-5572-6249--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Dragon Appeasement trigger.
Resolve the Dragon Appeasement trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1632-1987-4423-5243.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Stonespeaker Crystal by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Stonespeaker Crystal.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2835-5641-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2835-5641-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2246-2713-3657-6726.description:
Cast Ruby either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} due to Bard Class plus commander tax, if applicable.
Activate Ruby by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kogla by paying {G}, returning Ruby from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2246-2713-3657-6726.notes: If Bard Class is level 3, you will also exile your library with the ability to play the exiled cards until end of turn.

4613-4968-6582.description:
Activate Aerith Gainsborough by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Aerith Gainsborough triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

4826-5222-5231-6644.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise, adding {R}.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Sword of the Realms trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that are untapped due to Archelos.
Activate nine Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}{W}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Ancient Adamantoise.
Repeat.

2198-2440-5663--108.notablePrerequisites: You control a token copy of Deceiver Exarch.
2198-2440-5663--108.description:
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Deceiver Exarch token.
When the Deceiver Exarch token enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Deceiver Exarch trigger, untapping Cayth
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a type with the Deceiver Exarch token.
Repeat.
2198-2440-5663--108.notes: You must choose a card from the template that can make a token copy of Deceiver Exarch.

4613-4644-5329.easyPrerequisites:
You control a nontoken Merfolk that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Tidewater Minion exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
4613-4644-5329.description:
Activate the nontoken Merfolk using Tidewater Minion's ability by tapping it.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Merfolk's ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

3765-4838-6102.manaNeeded: {6}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
3765-4838-6102.notablePrerequisites:
You have not triggered Ashling's ability this turn.
You have another instant or sorcery spell in hand.
Your deck size is at least 2.
3765-4838-6102.description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, triggering Ashling.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Ashling triggers, causing you to rummage.
Resolve Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the Ashling trigger from step 1, dealling 2 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having less than 0 life.

1617-4831-4865-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Vesuvan Shapeshifter on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-4831-4865-4983-5358.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Vesuvan Shapeshifter to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

1170-2733-5334-5478-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

224-5627-5702.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-5627-5702.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

1283-2232-2608.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonartifact creature card in hand that can be cast using two mana or less.
1283-2232-2608.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast a nonartifact creature card from your hand by paying at most {2}.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Derevi from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Derevi by paying {3}.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Derevi trigger, untapping Cloudstone Curio.
Repeat.
1283-2232-2608.notes: If the creature can be cast using {1} or less, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may use Chromatic Orrery's second ability instead, if desired.

1308-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

389-2770-5248.description:
Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, giving Nine Lives to an opponent.
Cast Cleansing Nova by paying {3}{W}{W}, destroying all artifacts and enchantments.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, causing its controller to lose the game.
